How it's made.

It starts with one pass of drone video. No ground markers, no survey team.

Inputs · sorted on upload

Drop it all in with the video.

Each file is read, recognised and filed where it belongs. Nothing to fill in.

A log with no precision in it is reported as that, never given a made-up accuracy.

This demo flight: video only
Mandatory
✓ Drone video1080p / 4K
✓ GPS coordinateslat, lon, height
✓ Flight metadataclock, duration, datum
Optional
✓ IMU datagimbal attitude
✓ Barometric altitudeheight above take-off
✓ Camera intrinsicsfocal length, centre
✓ RTK / PPK correctionsfix quality → accuracy
